text: レッドは　みずのポケモン　ゼニガメに　きめるのじゃな？

structure.jp: みずのポケモン　ゼニガメに

patterns.name: 〜にきめる
patterns.span: ゼニガメに　きめる
patterns.explanation: A thing followed by にきめる says that is what you settle on. ゼニガメにきめる = 'decide on Squirtle'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ after a verb gives the feeling of checking or explaining how things are. Here it is のじゃ, the old-man form. きめるのじゃ = 'so it is that you decide'.

patterns.name: 〜な (confirmation)
patterns.explanation: な at the end asks the listener to agree, like ね but in an older man's voice. きめるのじゃな = 'you're deciding on it, right?'
